article.title: Objections to interrogatories by answer.
article.content: Any objection to answering any interrogatory on the ground that it is scandalous or irrelevant or not exhibited bona fide for the purpose of the suit, or that the matters inquired into are not sufficiently material at that stage, 4[or on the ground of privilege or any other ground], may be taken in the affidavit in answer.
article.html:
6Objections to interrogatories by answer.

Order 11, Rule 6

Any objection to answering any interrogatory on the ground that it is scandalous or irrelevant or not exhibited bona fide for the purpose of the suit, or that the matters inquired into are not sufficiently material at that stage, 4[or on the ground of privilege or any other ground], may be taken in the affidavit in answer.

4 Subs. by Act 104 of 1976, s. 61, for certain words (w.e.f. 1-2-1977).
